purpose: Deterministic routing metadata for selective GPT-Knowledge loading. This file points to canonical knowledge; it does not duplicate it.

projectFeatureFirst.rule: For project or feature work, load this guide before domain-specific knowledge, learn the active project/feature from live source and runtime evidence, then route to the smallest relevant domain set.

boot.rule: Load only the smallest task-relevant set, then inspect the live project/runtime.

routingRules: For any project or feature implementation, extension, replacement, integration, migration, planning, or learning task, load project-engineering/project-feature-implementation-plan.md before domain-specific knowledge.

For LBE Persistent Agent status, progress, workspace, or roadmap-boundary questions, additionally load project-engineering/projects/lbe-persistent-agent-wall-status.md, then revalidate the live repository before acting.

For LBE CLI control-plane, provider switching, coding/audit mode, pre-authorized edits/rules, external coding-agent integration, terminal relay, persistent agent-session, or request/result-envelope questions, additionally load ai-agents/lbe-cli-control-plane-provider-boundary.md and verify the live LBE runtime/Core implementation before prescribing changes.

Whenever an agent, LLM, local LLM, browser-side model, relay, bridge, router, or agent-to-agent transport is in scope, load ai-agents/agent-reasoning-transport-boundary.md early. Treat the agent/LLM as reasoning-capable by default; preserve semantic interpretation with the agent while transport owns delivery/integrity and governance owns hard authority constraints.

For agent/runtime audits, end-to-end claims, cleanup/reset work, destructive repository operations, force-push decisions, or reviews where focused tests may be mistaken for live behavior, load ai-agents/repeated-audit-failures-and-corrective-method.md and apply its stop conditions before conclusions or mutations.

Do not add parser/state-machine/hash-classifier intelligence to a relay merely to infer conversational meaning. First prove that the behavior is a hard transport, integrity, security, or deterministic-governance requirement rather than duplicated reasoning.
The project/feature plan and project status records must be grounded in active workspace source and runtime evidence; they must not become substitutes for live inspection.
Match the task to the fewest relevant domains.
Load canonical files first; load optional files only when their subtopic is actually in scope.
For agent work, load the unified problem-driven engineering guide first after the project/feature pre-route when applicable. Do not route by upstream repository name.
Select debugging, execution, memory, provider, recovery, or validation methods from the proven failure class and evidence before consulting source-specific references.
For Telegram integration, distinguish Bot API, local telegram-bot-api server, and MTProto/TL-schema requirements before selecting the implementation path.

Use ai-agents/studies/lobehub-agent-skills-system.md only when concrete implementation evidence is needed for tracing, durable work registration, deep review, skill freshness, heterogeneous agents, registry alignment, compatibility gates, or related LobeHub-derived patterns.

When a Letterblack debugging task implicates execution authority, governance, workspace guards, current-HEAD proof, or policy boundaries, load ai-agents/letterblack-governance-debugging-references.md only after the failure class is identified.
Use source-specific agent studies only as provenance or implementation examples after a method has been selected.
For Letterblack product UI, load the branding guide first after the project/feature pre-route when applicable; use Adobe_AI_Generations-04 only as a reference source, not as canonical brand truth.
Do not preload all domains.
Stop loading knowledge once there is enough context to inspect the live workspace/runtime.
Project-specific guidance and live runtime evidence take precedence over this routing metadata.
If no domain matches confidently, inspect the project first rather than loading unrelated knowledge.
